item: The task manager names a storage-guard wait for the keyword index rebuild (row 411)
summary: When the storage guard holds writes, the keyword index rebuild (the heal or the drain's end) waits with the marker kept; the task manager's waiting row now says so (writing to the database is paused because its storage needs attention) instead of showing nothing, keyed x12; once the guard lets go and memory and disk suffice, no waiting row
